info.title: Duet Ledger API
info.description: Cookie-authenticated local web API. Financial values use integer strings. Cross-account transfers require edit permission on every side. Remote API tokens and MCP are not implemented yet.

post.description: Available only before the first account exists. The first account becomes administrator; later requests return 409. Create this account before exposing the server publicly.
A valid sharing or account-only invitation, or an enabled public signup setting, is required. New accounts are never administrators. Sharing invitations still require owner approval.

post.summary: Confirm TOTP and receive recovery codes

parameters.name: trash
parameters.description: Only the caller own trashed ledgers are returned.

delete.summary: Owner moves a ledger and its accounts to recoverable trash
delete.description: All access to accounts and receipts is suspended until restore. Pending ledger/account invitations are cancelled.

delete.summary: Owner moves an account to recoverable trash
delete.description: Hides this account and its postings/receipts from every user. Transfer counterpart balance remains intact. Pending account invitations are cancelled. Existing grants resume on restore.

parameters.name: display_currency
parameters.description: Convert totals/categories/daily and add item display_currency/display_scale and leg display_amount. Original amounts and account currencies stay unchanged. Items without a conversion rate are listed in missing_currencies and excluded from converted aggregates.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reusing a key with different inputs returns 409.

post.description: New manual transactions accept only income, expense and transfer. Existing refund/adjustment data and migration imports remain compatible.

put.summary: Edit all affected sides with optimistic version
put.description: Returns id and posting_ids (account ID to posting ID) for authorized affected accounts. Existing refund/adjustment records may retain their original kind; ordinary records cannot be converted to a retired kind.

post.summary: Attach to a visible editable leg

file.description: JPEG/PNG, at most 5 MB and 16 million pixels.

get.summary: Export CSV or complete scoped JSON

post.summary: Preview or import into a new private ledger

get.summary: List categories permitted for an account or ledger

post.summary: Owner adds, renames, hides or restores a ledger category

post.description: Original records and existing sharing memberships become available again.

patch.summary: Administrator permits or closes public signup

get.description: Cancelled invitations are retained internally to reject tokens, but excluded from this list.

post.summary: Administrator creates a one-use 48 hour account invitation
post.description: Allows account creation even with public signup closed. Does not grant access to any existing ledger.

post.summary: Administrator cancels an unused account invitation

put.summary: Save the caller own ledger display order
Owner saves the complete category display order for one kind

get.summary: List caller owned deleted accounts in active ledgers

post.summary: Owner restores an account and existing sharing access

delete.summary: Permanently remove an owned ledger category
delete.description: Deletes the editable category and its ordering. Historical postings retain their display label, values and account permissions. Deleted IDs cannot be restored or reused. Existing records may retain their original deleted category when edited.

rate.description: Required for PUT. Account units per 1 source unit, max 12 fractional places.

put.description: Only affects the caller. Removes inverse pair to avoid conflicting direct/inverse values. Existing booked native amounts and per-transaction FX snapshots are unchanged.

rate.description: Required for PUT. Account units per 1 source unit, max 12 fractional places.

delete.description: Only affects the caller. Removes inverse pair to avoid conflicting direct/inverse values. Existing booked native amounts and per-transaction FX snapshots are unchanged.

tagline.description: Optional home subtitle. Empty uses the default message.

amount.description: Minimum currency units; signed only for adjustment.

time.description: Optional local clock time HH:mm; empty preserves unknown legacy time.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the entered date/time.

ledger_id.description: Optional entry context; source and transfer target must belong to this ledger.

original_currency.description: Optional original charge currency, different from account currency.

original_amount.description: Positive original amount as a minor-unit integer string.

exchange_rate.description: Account currency units per 1 original currency unit. Positive decimal, up to 12 fraction digits.

default_currency.description: User preference for default display and new account currency. Omission preserves the current preference. Does not convert balances.

default_account_id.description: Optional writable, unarchived account preference. Empty uses automatic selection. Scoped entry screens still restrict to their current ledger.

content.description: UTF-8 CSV; maximum 5 MB; date,kind,title,amount required headers.

data.description: A duet-ledger version 1 JSON export. A new private ledger is created; grants and images are not restored.

tagline.description: Optional home subtitle. Empty uses the default message.

code.description: Empty when adding; stable code when editing.

hidden.description: Must be false. To delete, use DELETE /api/ledgers/{id}/categories/{code}?kind=... .
